html:
Gustavus Adolphus was king of Sweden from 1611 to 1632. His army reforms and his intervention in the Thirty Years' War made Sweden a great power.

He came to the throne at sixteen, at war with Denmark, Russia and Poland. With his chancellor Axel Oxenstierna he reformed the state and built a national army of conscripts, with light cannon and flexible formations. He took lands around the Baltic from Russia and Poland.

In 1630 he landed in Germany to save the Protestant princes from the Catholic emperor. He crushed the imperial army at Breitenfeld in 1631, and was killed at Lützen in 1632 in a battle his army won. Sweden gained lands in Germany at the Peace of Westphalia. He founded the University of Tartu and the city of Gothenburg. See Sweden.
sum: Gustavus Adolphus was king of Sweden from 1611 to 1632. His army reforms and his intervention in the Thirty Years' War made Sweden a great power.
